728-2317-4826-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

1170-3110-8210.easyPrerequisites:
"Soul Tether" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
Konstrari Improviser is prepared.
1170-3110-8210.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Konstrari Improviser. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

4452-4881-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4452-4881-6909-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

222-527-1753-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1753-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

225-3129-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

765-2438-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

104-475-549-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-475-549-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-1368-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1251-1368-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7510.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2292-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5570-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
5570-5686-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

277-5702-5954-7288.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
277-5702-5954-7288.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-5702-5954-7288.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-3991-4681.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4090-6843.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Pariah causes that damage to be redirected to Anti-Venom.
Anti-Venom will then prevent the damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on it instead.

5010-5147-5708-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

511-560-817-4050-5902.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldier and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1497-2082-5660.description:
Cast Wild Cantor by paying its mana cost.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {R/G}.
When Wild Cantor dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

192-2910-3430.description:
Activate Castle Garenbrig's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G} and tapping it, adding eighteen {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Wakeroot Elemental by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}, untapping Castle Garenbrig and causing it to become a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land.
Repeat.
192-2910-3430.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you can use Wakeroot Elemental to untap any other land(s) infinitely

uses.battlefieldCardState: cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-4365-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to create two token copies of Éomer and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Put both Éomer tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Éomer tokens trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

273-801-3156-4763.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Impulsive Pilferer.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, targeting Koll.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2092-3525-4758-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
2092-3525-4758-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

618-2921-3991.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

requires.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it
with a takeover counter on it

5326-5686--5--6.notablePrerequisites:
Both the persist and undying creatures are in exile with at least one takeover counter on them.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of either the persist or undying creature.
The Master does not have a +1/+1 counter on it if it is a copy of the undying creature, or a -1/-1 counter on it otherwise.
5326-5686--5--6.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

3057-5703-5744.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have a way to give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance.
3057-5703-5744.description:
Give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance by any method.
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Bloodthirster from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Roshan, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Bloodthirster token.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

974-2136-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2136-2178.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it and Orthion trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Orthion trigger, untapping it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

678-1418-4050-4151.description:
Cast Vishgraz by paying {2}{W}{B}{G}.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

369-650-4050.notablePrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-650-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake, adding one mana of any color.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Repeat.

262-3459-4321.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Battered Golem.
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness and has a power of 1 or greater.
262-3459-4321.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1350-2103-4423.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

878-2474-3059.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus, deal damage equal to three times Malignus's power to target opponent, and create three Treasure tokens.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2776-5089-5200.notablePrerequisites: Doubling Cube does not have summoning sickness.
2776-5089-5200.description:
Float at least {11} in your mana pool.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {8}.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Doubling Cube to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Sword of the Paruns' equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to Doubling Cube.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Doubling Cube.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {7}.
Repeat from step 5.

333-2034-2820.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos, adding {C}{C}.
Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, triggering Angelic Renewal, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

618-1817.description:
Cast Kiki-Jiki by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {U}{G}, creating a non-legendary token copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the untapped non-legendary Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 3.

565-1858-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Lands able to tap for {1}{U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-3542.description:
Cast View from Above targeting Palinchron.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
The token Palinchron enters, untapping seven lands you control.
View from Above resolves, returning to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other permanents you control in step 1, gaining infinite copies of those permanents in step 2.

1479-4300.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped.
1479-4300.description:
Activate Meloku the Clouded Mirror by paying {1} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 blue Illusion creature token with flying.
When the Illusion enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, allowing you to put the same land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-2757-4499-5251.notablePrerequisites: At least 1 basic land under your control.
2034-2757-4499-5251.description:
Activate Earthcraft to tap Emmara, Soul of the Accord and untap a basic land.
Tap the land for mana.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord triggers creating a token creature.
Activate Earthcraft to tap the token creature to untap a basic land.
Tap the land for mana.
Sacrifice the token creature to Ashnod's Altar floating {2}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed to exile Emmara, Soul of the Accord then return her to the battlefield untapped.
Repeat.

2026-3230-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
2026-3230-4222.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
